settings.label: factory
settings.validation: the 20 instances the trainer builds from the training configuration of 10x25+family+xmask-v1-s301, the instances the training runs validated on
settings.verdict_rule: ahead: 95% interval below zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p for shorter (seed t, bootstrap) below 0.05; behind: interval above zero and both Holm-adjusted one-sided p for longer below 0.05 (own Holm step); otherwise not distinguishable
settings.statistics: d = 100 (a - b) / b per training seed and test instance; crossed hierarchical bootstrap over seeds and instances (stats_family.hier_boot, B = 20000, fresh numpy default_rng(11) per quantity), 95% percentile interval without Bonferroni widening; one-sided seed-level t test (k - 1 df) and one-sided bootstrap p, Holm over the combinations of each arm and form (the stats_family calls of p89_public_family.component, stats_family.holm)
settings.protocol_note: The study of 2026-11-11 widened its intervals by Bonferroni over the eight combinations (alpha 0.05/8); the protocol of manuscript/supp_new/sn07_statistics.tex uses 95% intervals and Holm on the one-sided tests, which this script follows.

forms.greedy_best4: one greedy schedule vs the per-instance best of the four rules

forms.sample4: best of 4 sampled vs the per-instance best of the four rule schedules
forms.sample16: best of 16 sampled vs the per-instance best of 16 rule schedules (four rules x tie-break seeds 50-53)
forms.greedy3: greedy plus 3 sampled vs the per-instance best of the four rules
forms.greedy15: greedy plus 15 sampled vs the per-instance best of 16 rule schedules
